_README: Curated sync collections. Every collection is built from albums Dr. Bishop grouped herself (her playlists + SYNC/CATALOG_ROUTING.md) — no mood was inferred from a track title alone. Adding one = one object here. 'listen' is a Spotify playlist id where one of her playlists already covers this ground.
_rights: One-stop: master and publishing both held by Pharoah Phoenix LLC. Writer: Nicole Aimee Bishop (ASCAP).

collections.name: Wellness & Ambient
collections.line: Instrumental. No lyrics to clear, nothing competing with dialogue.
collections.note: NARROW + SUPPLE is BPM-tagged in the track titles (80–115), built around movement cues.

collections.name: Sultry & Sophisticated
collections.line: Pop jazz with a wink. Grown, warm, unhurried.

collections.name: Latin & Multilingual
collections.line: Spanish-language, front to back. Flamenco, bolero, reggaetón, drama.

collections.name: Caribbean & Tropical
collections.line: Island heat, soca and Afro grooves.

collections.name: Kizomba & Lusophone
collections.line: Slow, close, danceable. French and Portuguese.

collections.name: Empowerment & Swagger
collections.line: Affirmation records. Built to lift a scene, not sit under it.
collections.note: Contains explicit language; clean versions available on request.

collections.name: Instrumental Grooves
collections.line: Funk and lo-fi instrumentals. Sits under dialogue without fighting it.

collections.name: Attitude & Tension
collections.line: Alt rock with teeth. Loud, sharp, cathartic.
collections.note: Explicit throughout. Clean versions available on request.

collections.name: Retail & Boutique Pop
collections.line: Warm pop for a room people are moving through.
collections.note: Designated for retail and background use by the artist.
